verdict.rationale: Groq documents serving customized models: you upload existing LoRA adapters and run inference on them on Groq's infrastructure. Its docs explicitly describe these as "pre-made" adapters, so the fine-tuning itself must happen elsewhere. That covers only the serving half of the story. Missing for 10: on-platform fine-tuning or training jobs on your own data, a documented end-to-end train-then-deploy workflow, the list of base models supported for LoRA, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.
